services.name: Teams & Lessons
services.desc: John grew up locally and swam in the NVSL and for several Club teams, through college where he held the university 200 backstroke record. He began coaching NVSL swimmers in the mid 1990s and became a USA Swimming club coach in 2000. Over the past 20+ years John has had the opportunity to work with kids and adults at every ability level including learn to swim classes, club swim, collegiate, national, international and Olympic level athletes. He really enjoys teaching others how to improve their swimming skills and seeing them progress in competition. Hi! My name is Alaina, and I’m a rising junior at Yorktown.
